Needs changes before merge: add the required screenshots. All local checks passed.

I read the complete diff and issue #3667. I checked the rules in current upstream `AGENTS.md`.
The trial merge used upstream main `10ea81a2a1da2f883d43385757db802e83c99fd1`.
Its first parent is the PR head above. The merge was clean.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_settings.rs:282` and the PR body: the UI change has no before/after screenshots. Add both screenshots to the PR body. Show the tool number action with T1 reserved for a probe, including the visible refusal after the change. Store the images on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Do not commit them to the PR branch.

The code uses the same reservation allocation as `AddTool`. The new tests cover the queued number command and the refusal text. I found no code blocker.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Hi @shadaytree. All local checks passed on this PR. The only open item from the last review is the before/after screenshots of the tool window.

To help it through, we are making those screenshots on our side with the off-screen renderer. They will go in a comment here shortly. When they are up, paste the table into the PR body (or tell us and we will), then mark the PR ready. A collaborator review of the same head then clears it.

Hi @shadaytree. Here are the before/after screenshots for the last review item.

### Screenshots

The state is the one that the review asks for. The mounted machine `SHOT VMC` reserves T1 for a probe. In the Tool library, **New tool…** opens the editor. The tool name is `EM-6`, and the user types **Tool number 1**. Then the user clicks **Add tool**.

| Step | Before (merge base `ddee3aed6`) | After (PR head `b206931ab`) |
|---|---|---|
| Tool number 1 typed | ![before typed](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/beb89f265ea7c794034dceb9261867f986a9a137/3976/before-1-typed.png) | ![after typed](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/beb89f265ea7c794034dceb9261867f986a9a137/3976/after-1-typed.png) |
| After **Add tool** | ![before added](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/beb89f265ea7c794034dceb9261867f986a9a137/3976/before-2-added.png) The tool gets T2. No message tells the user that T1 was not used. Status: `tool EM-6 added (T2)`. | ![after added](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/beb89f265ea7c794034dceb9261867f986a9a137/3976/after-2-added.png) The tool gets T2. The refusal is visible in the Tool library, in Properties and in the status bar: `tool number not set: invalid parameters: tool 'EM-6' (T1): T1 is reserved for probe on SHOT VMC`. |

How the images were made:

- Off-screen render only: `egui_kittest` with the headless wgpu device. No window opened.
- A temporary test in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/edm_tool_visibility.rs` drove the real shell UI. The test did not go into a commit.
- Before: commit `ddee3aed6064eefe157110ab8923dbb02e1591ca` (the merge base of this PR on upstream `main`).
- After: commit `b206931ab71e6b39e56c9af107136b0e4ec23547` (the current PR head).
- The images are on the images-only branch `pr-screenshots` of `mkinney/Camcraft`, at commit `beb89f265ea7c794034dceb9261867f986a9a137`. The links use that commit, so they do not change.

Paste this table into the PR body under Screenshots (or tell us and we will), then mark the PR ready (Ready for review, or gh pr ready 3976). A collaborator review of the same head then clears it.

@shadaytree, we added the screenshot table from our earlier comment to the PR body under "Screenshots" and marked the PR ready for review. No code changed. A collaborator review of head `b206931ab` now checks the last item. You do not need to do anything.

Clean. This is a re-review of the same head. The one open item from the earlier review is now done.

Owner record: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3976#issuecomment-7200791502

## Earlier findings

Earlier review: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3976#issuecomment-7156766544

1. Before/after screenshots of the tool number action, with T1 reserved for a probe: **fixed**. The PR body has a "Screenshots" table. I read the four images at the fixed commit `beb89f265ea7c794034dceb9261867f986a9a137` of the images-only branch `pr-screenshots`. They show the state that the review asked for:
   - Typed state: machine `SHOT VMC`, new tool `EM-6`, Tool number 1. The before and after images are the same file, because the typed state does not change.
   - Before, after **Add tool**: the tool gets T2. The status bar shows only `tool EM-6 added (T2)`. No message tells the user that T1 was not used.
   - After, after **Add tool**: the tool gets T2, and the refusal `tool number not set: invalid parameters: tool 'EM-6' (T1): T1 is reserved for probe on SHOT VMC` is visible in the Tool library, in Properties and in the status bar.
   - No image is committed to the PR branch.

## Trial merge with newer main

Upstream main moved 404 commits since the earlier review. Main changed `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_settings.rs` too. Thus I made a new trial merge and built it again.

- Base: upstream main `773736856c6968994f3de8c301a19bd735366d70`. The first parent of the merge is the PR head above.
- The merge was clean (`tool_settings.rs` auto-merged). The merged tree still calls `tool_numbers::next_free_for` at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_settings.rs:296`.

## Local build and tests (on the new trial merge)

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 29 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (8.3 min). The host has a GPU (Apple M5 Max, Metal), so the UI suites ran in full.
  - post: build, `lib`, `tool_reservations`, `tool_reservations_cli`.
  - app: build, `lib`, `catalog_groove_part_off`, `continuous_4axis_part`, `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, `first_4axis_part`, `first_part_programs`, `first_router_part`, `tilt_basis_compat`, `tool_numbers`, `tool_reservations`, `tool_reservations_extra`, `tool_reservations_version`.
  - ui: build, `lib`, `boundary`, `boundary_picks`, `contour_dxf_sketch`, `sinker_setup`, `tap_hand`, `theme_example`, `theme_files`, `waterjet_tool`.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

Extra suites run: `app suites: example_catalog` and the other catalog suites ran by name in the quick gate, and passed. No fixture, golden or importer file changed, so the extra fixture and STEP suite rules do not apply.

## Safety

The PR changes the number that the UI compares before it queues `SetToolNumber`, and the text of two refusals. It does not change posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation or geometry. Thus this is not a safety-tier review, and no mutation runs apply. No goldens moved. No heavy lane is reached.

## Optional, non-blocking

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_settings.rs:278`: the doc comment still names `next_free`. The code calls `next_free_for`.
